title: Argentinian Duck Cassoulet
description: A rich and flavorful casserole originating from South America, featuring tender duck, fragrant herbs, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Season the duck legs with salt, pepper, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck legs until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the duck from the pot and set it aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the sliced onion to the pot.
Cook the onion until softened and caramelized, about 20 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Bring the wine to a simmer and cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the duck legs to the pot and add the cannellini beans.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 25 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and add the bay leaves.
Return the pot to the oven and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
